prompt:
Paint the COMPLETE top-down map of one floor of a haunted gothic manor, as ONE finished game map image, in rich premium modern hi-bit pixel art (the "HD pixel art" JRPG look: hand-placed crisp square pixels, hue-shifted ramps, dark warm outlines), flat classic top-down RPG dungeon map view (NOT an HD-2D diorama, no depth-of-field, no tilt-shift, no 3D render).

This is the GROUND FLOOR of the Mist Manor, the abandoned grand house of a long-dead marsh witch, standing alone in a fog-bound swamp: a dungeon floor seen from above. Rooms: at the south the ENTRANCE HALL with a long faded crimson runner leading north from the front porch (the porch opening at the bottom edge is the way out); to the west the DINING ROOM (dark oak parquet) and above it the LIBRARY (dark wood floor); to the east the KITCHEN (grey flagstones) and above it a ruined glass CONSERVATORY, its glass roof long gone, now overgrown with marsh grass, ferns and a small murky pond; in the middle an open-air inner COURTYARD garden, overgrown lawn with clipped yew hedges at the corners and a dry round stone FOUNTAIN whose statue is a robed woman holding up a bell; at the north the GREAT HALL (grey flagstones) with a crimson runner leading to a grand staircase going up at the top middle. The whole house is grand but decaying: grey stone walls stained by damp, ivy and marsh moss creeping in through cracks, cobwebs in the corners, dust on the floors, wallpaper peeling on the wall faces, tall arched windows (dark, night outside) painted on the wall faces, old portraits and tapestries on the wall faces.

The attached image is an exact LAYOUT GUIDE (trace over it: your painting will be laid pixel-for-pixel on top of it and checked against it, so do not shift, shrink, mirror or re-arrange anything; keep every edge within a few pixels of the guide) drawn on a 48 x 40 tile grid (each tile = 40 x 40 px of the output, output is 1920 x 1600). Every shape must sit exactly where it is in the guide at the same size: this image is used directly as the walkable game map, so positions are collision data.

Guide colour key:
- very dark blue-grey = solid WALL MASS seen from above (the tops of thick stone walls): dark slate, simple, unwalkable, the outside of the map is also solid.
- mid grey-violet bands directly above a floor = the WALL FACES: the vertical inner face of each wall, seen from the room (grey dressed stone with a dark wainscot, peeling wallpaper, arched dark windows, portraits, sconces), standing on the floor edge.
- grey tiles = flagstone floor (walkable); brown with plank lines = dark wooden floor (walkable); crimson with gold edges = carpet runners and rugs (walkable); green = overgrown grass (walkable); dark green circles = clipped yew hedges (solid); teal = murky water (not walkable).
- the round pale basin with a figure in the courtyard = the dry stone fountain with the statue of a woman holding a bell (solid).
- pale stepped strip = the staircase.
Rooms, doorways and wall faces must not move or change size.

Make everything rich, detailed, handcrafted and cohesive, like a lovingly painted JRPG dungeon map of a sad, beautiful haunted manor. Floors must stay FLAT and OPEN (no furniture standing on the walkable floor: no tables, chairs, beds, shelves, chests, candelabra, statues, boxes, dolls, pianos or clutter on the floor; the game places those as separate sprites). Rugs, floor patterns, cracks, fallen leaves, dust and a few scattered sheet-music pages lying flat are good.

Pixel art rules: crisp square pixels, no blur, no anti-aliasing, no painterly brush strokes, no noise, clear clusters, hue-shifted ramps, dark warm outlines. Characters in this game are about 120 output px tall, so details should be at that scale.
Lighting: this is the ALBEDO base layer. Neutral, soft, even light; NO night darkness, NO cast shadows longer than a few pixels, NO candle light pools, NO glow, NO vignette, NO fog, NO mist.
Do NOT paint any characters, ghosts, animals, furniture, lamps, candles, chests, text, labels, grid lines or UI.
revised_prompt: Edit/paint OVER the user's attached 1920x1600 layout guide as a strictly registered image-to-image pixel-art map. Produce ONE complete 1920x1600 flat orthographic classic top-down JRPG game-map image. Crucial: trace the guide EXACTLY, preserving every boundary, doorway, room footprint, threshold, carpet width and length, staircase, hedge location, round fountain position, pond outline and exterior void, with no translation/scaling/mirroring or redesign whatsoever. 48x40 tiles, 40px per tile. The input's dark charcoal outside and wall masses remain solid in exactly the same places; gray-violet bands are upright inward-facing dressed stone wall faces; gray squares flagstone; brown planking wooden floor; crimson/gold carpet; grassy green grass; dark green hedge circles; teal conservatory pond. Replace its schematic colors and drawn grid with beautifully cohesive premium HD pixel art, hand-placed crisp SQUARE pixel clusters, tasteful hue-shifted color ramps and dark warm outlines, absolutely no antialiasing/blur/3D/tilt/lighting effects. The broad northern great hall has open grey worn flagstone and its exactly registered vertical central faded crimson gold-edged runner leading to the small staircase in its north central wall. The central open air rectangular courtyard has patchy walkable grass, four precisely placed clusters of clipped yews, central circular DRY pale stone fountain with small top-view robed woman sculpture holding a bell, statue confined entirely within existing fountain footprint. Upper-left wood-floored library and lower-left wood-floored dining room remain empty open walkable floor, dark oak plank/parquet variation and worn finish. Upper-right ruined roofless conservatory has marsh grass, ferns and its existing small right-side murky rectangular pond, absolutely no changed water footprint; lower-right grey flagstone kitchen empty of furniture. Lower-middle entrance hall grey flagstone with precisely guide-aligned long crimson gold-edged runner; bottom centered open stone front porch extending to the very bottom edge. Preserve narrow transitions, unusual wall projections and the blank charcoals EXACTLY. Rich restrained environmental details primarily on vertical INNER WALL FACES: peeling wallpaper over damp dressed stone and dark wainscot, tall dark arched night windows, gothic portraits and threadbare tapestries mounted FLAT on walls, tiny ivy vines, moss, cobwebs; sparse fine cracks, dust, a few fallen leaves and scattered sheet-music pages lying FLAT on floor. No furnishings or props protruding onto floor: NO tables, chairs, beds, shelves, cabinets, chests, floor candles/candelabra, lamps, piano, boxes, clutter, figures, ghosts, animals. Retain flat and broadly OPEN walkable regions. Soft neutral EVEN ALBEDO, no actual night-dark lighting despite dark painted windows; no glow, mist, vignette, directional light or long shadows. No text, labels, tile grid lines, UI, or image borders. The map is used pixel-for-pixel for collision data, so geometric fidelity to original reference is MORE IMPORTANT than extra decorative ideas.
